_doc: M6-A3 per-usercmd zipline model for Unity (Source units, u/s). Labels: meas = measured here, fit = fitted here (residual given), src = source audit / census, unknown = not determined. See A3-ZIPLINE.md.

input: +use press edge (IN_USE 0x20), mounts on the press command itself
search_origin_raise: src+fit (Find points reproduce with this origin)
find_radius: fit (|Q-P| of every pitch-0 Find point)
find_point_rule: argmin angle(eyeDir, Q-P) over rope points Q with |Q-P| <= radius (flat/sloped ropes; every Find point reproduced to 0.1 deg / 0.1 u)
find_point_rule_vertical: rope point at origin.z + 80.1 (hang height), not the min-angle point
position_integration: x_k = x_(k-1) + v_k * dt along the rope (same-cmd speed)

state2_duration_s: meas (accel switch at k=60, dedi state 2->3 at the same cmd; a speed threshold 300 is not excluded)
slope_effect: none: same |v| profile along the rope on the uphill rope
vertical: same profile up the vertical rope

auto_rope_rule: after the ride step, if (remaining to the end - v*dt) < 90 (= autoDetach 100 - 10) detach at the current position with v_out
fit (remaining after the detach cmd 90.1..94.8 u)
auto_rope_stop_short_u: meas (distance to the rope end of origin+80 at the detach)
auto_vertical: v_out = vertical ride velocity (600, below the 1500 clamp) + 400 horizontal along the view yaw
jump_off: v_out = h_rope * min(v_ride, 400) + z * 289.83 (= sqrt(2 g jumpHeight)); keys ignored on the jump cmd; the jump cmd itself does not translate
fit (2 ride speeds), residual in A3-ZIPLINE.md
jump_off_view_pitch_law: unknown (view locked to the rope pitch while riding)
post_exit_air_control: standard air accel 500 u/s^2, wish cap 69 (M2), from the first post-exit cmd
client_dedi_offset: client hangs 0.17 u lower and 0.23 u to -y of the dedi; carried into the exit

applies: meas: second jump K=1..12,40 frames after the jump-off is ignored (airborne, no grace)

remount_budget: 3, +1 per 3 s, reset on landing (SDK bridge_zip_disc)
